app_store.name: Rabeya Furniture
app_store.subtitle: Handmade decor, fairly priced
app_store.promotional_text: Free Dhaka delivery from ৳500. One WhatsApp thread per order, with a name on it. No hidden fees, no advance payment.
app_store.description:
Rabeya Furniture is a small home-decor workshop in Dhaka. Every piece is hand-made, every order ships with the price on the product card, and the price you see is the price you pay.

What you get:
- Free Dhaka delivery from ৳500. Outside Dhaka: ৳150, free from ৳2,500.
- One WhatsApp thread per order, with a name on it. A 6-hour reply, in Bengali, during business hours.
- Verified-buyer reviews on every product, with the reviewer's district.
- A live trust dashboard on /about: orders today, median delivery, return rate, response time.
- Thana / district search at checkout, not a 64-item dropdown.
- 7-day return on unused items in original packaging. Refuse a damaged delivery, no questions.
- Cash on delivery. No advance, no platform fee, no hidden line items at checkout.

How it works:
1. Pick a piece. The price on the card is the price you pay, shipping on the same line.
2. Fill the form: name, phone, thana, address. We text you a copy of your order on WhatsApp.
3. Pay the courier when the product is in your hand. Check the box. Pay.

For returning customers: a 5% loyalty code (RABEYA05) on the second order, and priority WhatsApp from a single named agent on whole-house orders (৳8,000+).
